subjects.subject: Discrete Mathematics
topics: Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices
Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions

subjects.subject: Probability and Statistics
topics: Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions
Mean, median, mode and standard deviation

subjects.subject: Digital Logic
topics: Boolean algebra and minimization - algebraic technique, Karnaugh map, tabular method
Design of combinational and sequential circuits
Number representation and arithmetic (fixed and floating point)

subjects.subject: Computer Organization and Architecture
topics: Design of arithmetic and logic unit (ALU)
Design of control unit - hardwired and microprogrammed
Memory interfacing and hierarchy: performance, cache memory mapping

subjects.subject: Programming and Data Structures
topics: Trees, binary search trees, binary heaps

subjects.subject: Algorithms
topics: Asymptotic worst case time and space complexity
Algorithm design techniques: greedy, dynamic programming and divide-and-conquer
Graph traversals, minimum spanning trees, shortest paths

subjects.subject: Theory of Computation
topics: Regular and context-free languages, pumping lemma

subjects.subject: Compiler Design
topics: Data flow analyses: constant propagation, liveness analysis, common sub expression elimination

subjects.subject: Operating System
topics: System calls, processes, threads, inter-process communication

subjects.subject: Databases
topics: Relational model: relational algebra, tuple calculus, SQL
File organization, indexing (e.g., B and B+ trees)

subjects.subject: Computer Networks
topics: Basics of switching (circuit, packet and virtual circuit) and performance metrics
Data link layer: error detection, Medium Access Control, Ethernet
Distance vector and link state routing
IPv4 - Fragmentation, CIDR Notation, Network Address Translation
TCP - flow control and congestion control, socket API
